  (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]

example : ρ.OrbitsInAffineOpen := inferInstance

section ModelShape
variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
  (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]

-- the model at A = Gamma(X, top), with the letI instances the file uses
example : True := by
  have hU : ρ.IsStableOpen ⊤ := fun _ => rfl
  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebra f (⊤ : X.Opens)
  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f (⊤ : X.Opens)
  haveI := SemilinearGalAction.sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f (⊤ : X.Opens)

  have : X = Spec (CommRingCat.of (Γ(X, ⊤) : Type u)) := by
    sorry
  trivial
end ModelShape

144	/-! ## Transport of sections along the action, on a stable open -/
145	
146	section ActApp
147	
148	variable (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) {U : X.Opens} (hU : ρ.IsStableOpen U)
149	
150	/-- Transport of sections over a `Γ`-stable open along `act γ`: the pullback map
151	`(act γ)^♯` from `Γ(X, U)` to `Γ(X, (act γ)⁻¹ U) = Γ(X, U)`. -/
152	noncomputable def actApp (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) : Γ(X, U) ⟶ Γ(X, U) :=
153	  (ρ.act γ).hom.appLE U U (hU γ).ge
154	
155	lemma actApp_one : ρ.actApp hU 1 = 𝟙 Γ(X, U) := by
156	  rw [actApp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_congr_hom ρ.act_one_hom]
157	  exact (Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app (𝟙 X)).trans (Scheme.Hom.id_app U)
158	
159	/-- The transport is contravariantly functorial in `γ` (categorical composition
160	order: `γ` pulls back first). -/
161	lemma actApp_mul (γ τ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
162	    ρ.actApp hU (γ * τ) = ρ.actApp hU γ ≫ ρ.actApp hU τ := by
163	  rw [actApp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_congr_hom (ρ.act_mul_hom γ τ)]
164	  exact (Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE _ _ _ _ _ _ _).symm
165	
166	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
167	lemma actApp_actApp_inv (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
168	    ρ.actApp hU γ ≫ ρ.actApp hU γ⁻¹ = 𝟙 Γ(X, U) := by
169	  rw [← actApp_mul, mul_inv_cancel, actApp_one]
170	
171	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
172	lemma actApp_inv_actApp (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
173	    ρ.actApp hU γ⁻¹ ≫ ρ.actApp hU γ = 𝟙 Γ(X, U) := by
174	  rw [← actApp_mul, inv_mul_cancel, actApp_one]
175	
176	/-- The `Γ`-action by ring automorphisms on the sections over a `Γ`-stable open:
177	`γ • s = (act γ⁻¹)^♯ s`.  The inversion makes it a **left** action (transport of
178	sections is contravariant) and matches the affine model: for `X = Spec A`, `U = ⊤`,
179	`act γ = Spec (γ⁻¹ • ·)` (`toSpecAut`), so `γ • s` recovers the ring action of `γ`.
180	A def, not an instance — it depends on the stability proof `hU`. -/
181	@[reducible]
182	noncomputable def sectionsMulSemiringAction : MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) Γ(X, U) where
183	  smul γ s := (ρ.actApp hU γ⁻¹).hom s
184	  one_smul s := by
185	    change (ρ.actApp hU 1⁻¹).hom s = s
186	    rw [inv_one, actApp_one]
187	    rfl
188	  mul_smul γ τ s := by
189	    change (ρ.actApp hU (γ * τ)⁻¹).hom s = (ρ.actApp hU γ⁻¹).hom ((ρ.actApp hU τ⁻¹).hom s)
190	    rw [mul_inv_rev, actApp_mul]
191	    rfl
192	  smul_zero γ := map_zero (ρ.actApp hU γ⁻¹).hom
193	  smul_add γ s t := map_add (ρ.actApp hU γ⁻¹).hom s t
194	  smul_one γ := map_one (ρ.actApp hU γ⁻¹).hom
195	  smul_mul γ s t := map_mul (ρ.actApp hU γ⁻¹).hom s t
196	
197	lemma sectionsMulSemiringAction_smul_def (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (s : Γ(X, U)) :
198	    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
199	    γ • s = ρ.actApp hU γ⁻¹ s := rfl
200	
201	/-- **The norm of a section over a stable open is `Γ`-invariant** (the section-level
202	face of the `StableAffineCover` norm trick): for any `s : Γ(X, U)`,
203	`τ • ∏_γ γ • s = ∏_γ γ • s`.  Feeds the invariant-basic-open covering of stable
204	opens inside a chart (glue layer 2). -/
205	lemma smul_norm_of_finite [FiniteDimensional K L] (s : Γ(X, U)) (τ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
206	    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
207	    τ • (∏ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, γ • s) = ∏ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, γ • s := by
208	  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
209	  have h : τ • (∏ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, γ • s) = ∏ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, τ • (γ • s) :=
210	    map_prod (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom (L ≃ₐ[K] L) Γ(X, U) τ) _ _
211	  rw [h, Finset.prod_congr rfl fun γ _ => (mul_smul τ γ s).symm]
212	  exact Fintype.prod_equiv (Equiv.mulLeft τ) _ _ fun γ => rfl
213	
214	/-- Naturality of the section transport in the stable open: transporting then
215	restricting between two stable opens is restricting then transporting.  (In
216	particular the restriction map between stable opens is `Γ`-equivariant for the
217	section actions, hence maps invariants to invariants — the map that glue layer 2
218	localizes.) -/
219	lemma actApp_map {V : X.Opens} (hV : ρ.IsStableOpen V) (hVU : V ≤ U)
220	    (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
221	    ρ.actApp hU γ ≫ X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op
222	      = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op ≫ ρ.actApp hV γ := by
223	  rw [actApp, actApp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
224	
225	/-- **The basic open of an invariant section over a stable open is stable.**  The
226	invariance hypothesis is pinned inverse-free through the transport `actApp` (for the
227	section action it reads `γ • N = N` for all `γ`).  Together with
228	`smul_norm_of_finite`/`isStableOpen_basicOpen_prod_actApp` this is the
229	invariant-basic-open covering machine of glue layer 2. -/
230	lemma isStableOpen_basicOpen {N : Γ(X, U)}
231	    (hN : ∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, ρ.actApp hU γ N = N) :
232	    ρ.IsStableOpen (X.basicOpen N) := by
233	  intro γ
234	  have h1 : ρ.actApp hU γ N
235	      = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hU γ).ge).op ((ρ.act γ).hom.app U N) := rfl
236	  have hle : X.basicOpen ((ρ.act γ).hom.app U N) ≤ U :=
237	    (X.basicOpen_le _).trans_eq (hU γ)
238	  calc (ρ.act γ).hom ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen N
239	      = X.basicOpen ((ρ.act γ).hom.app U N) := Scheme.preimage_basicOpen _ _
240	    _ = U ⊓ X.basicOpen ((ρ.act γ).hom.app U N) := (inf_eq_right.mpr hle).symm
241	    _ = X.basicOpen (ρ.actApp hU γ N) := by rw [h1, Scheme.basicOpen_res]
242	    _ = X.basicOpen N := by rw [hN γ]
243	
244	/-- The basic open of the **norm** `∏_γ (act γ)^♯ s` of *any* section over a stable
245	open is stable — the section-level norm trick, transport form. -/
246	lemma isStableOpen_basicOpen_prod_actApp [FiniteDimensional K L] (s : Γ(X, U)) :
247	    ρ.IsStableOpen (X.basicOpen (∏ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, ρ.actApp hU γ s)) := by
248	  refine ρ.isStableOpen_basicOpen hU fun τ => ?_
249	  have h : ρ.actApp hU τ (∏ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, ρ.actApp hU γ s)
250	      = ∏ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, ρ.actApp hU τ (ρ.actApp hU γ s) :=
251	    map_prod (ρ.actApp hU τ).hom _ _
252	  have h2 : ∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
253	      ρ.actApp hU τ (ρ.actApp hU γ s) = ρ.actApp hU (γ * τ) s := by
254	    intro γ
255	    rw [actApp_mul]
256	    rfl
257	  rw [h, Finset.prod_congr rfl fun γ _ => h2 γ]
258	  exact Fintype.prod_equiv (Equiv.mulRight τ) _ _ fun γ => rfl
259	
260	end ActApp

302	transporting the structure map along `act γ` twists it by `γ⁻¹` (the same inversion

304	lemma actApp_sectionsAlgebraMapHom (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
305	    sectionsAlgebraMapHom f U ≫ ρ.actApp hU γ
306	      = CommRingCat.ofHom (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L γ⁻¹)
307	          ≫ sectionsAlgebraMapHom f U := by
308	  rw [sectionsAlgebraMapHom, actApp, Category.assoc,
309	    Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE, Scheme.Hom.appLE_congr_hom (ρ.compat γ),
310	    Scheme.Hom.appLE_congr_hom
311	      (congrArg (f ≫ ·) (toSpecAut_hom (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L γ)),
312	    Scheme.Hom.comp_appLE, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
313	  congr 1

315	    (CommRingCat.ofHom (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L γ⁻¹))).symm

317	/-- **The section action on a stable open is semilinear** over the Galois action on
318	`L`: with the (`letI`) instances `sectionsMulSemiringAction` and `sectionsAlgebra`,

379	model on `Spec Γ(X, U)` by `actRes_isoSpec_hom_toSpecAut` below. -/
380	noncomputable def restrict : SemilinearGalAction K L U.toScheme (U.ι ≫ f) where
381	  act := MonoidHom.mk'
382	    (fun γ =>
383	      { hom := ρ.actRes hU γ
384	        inv := ρ.actRes hU γ⁻¹
385	        hom_inv_id := ρ.actRes_actRes_inv hU γ
386	        inv_hom_id := ρ.actRes_inv_actRes hU γ })
387	    (fun γ τ => by
388	      refine Iso.ext ?_
389	      change ρ.actRes hU (γ * τ) = ρ.actRes hU τ ≫ ρ.actRes hU γ
390	      exact ρ.actRes_mul hU γ τ)
391	  compat γ := by
392	    change ρ.actRes hU γ ≫ (U.ι ≫ f) = (U.ι ≫ f) ≫ (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L γ).hom
393	    rw [← Category.assoc, actRes_ι, Category.assoc, ρ.compat γ, Category.assoc]

396	    ((ρ.restrict hU).act γ).hom = ρ.actRes hU γ := rfl
397	
398	/-- **Spec-functoriality of the section transport** (milestone 1, bridge to the
399	affine engine): on an affine `Γ`-stable open, `hUa.isoSpec` intertwines the
400	restricted action morphism `act γ |_U` with `Spec` of the section transport

402	theorem actRes_isoSpec_hom (hUa : IsAffineOpen U) (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
403	    ρ.actRes hU γ ≫ hUa.isoSpec.hom = hUa.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (ρ.actApp hU γ) := by
404	  haveI : IsAffine U.toScheme := hUa
405	  have hiso : hUa.isoSpec.hom = U.toScheme.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map U.topIso.inv := rfl
406	  rw [hiso, ← Category.assoc, ← Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality (ρ.actRes hU γ),
407	    Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
408	  congr 2
409	  have happ : (ρ.actRes hU γ).appTop
410	      = U.topIso.hom ≫ ρ.actApp hU γ ≫ U.topIso.inv :=
411	    Scheme.Hom.resLE_app_top _ _
412	  rw [happ, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
413	
414	/-- Spec-functoriality, `toSpecAut` form: on an affine `Γ`-stable open the
415	restricted action corresponds under `isoSpec` to the affine-model action
416	`toSpecAut` of the section action `sectionsMulSemiringAction` on `Spec Γ(X, U)` —
417	i.e. `hUa.isoSpec.hom` is equivariant.  (Bundling this as
418	`SemilinearGalAction.IsEquivariant` of `ρ.restrict hU` against
419	`specSemilinearGalAction` is glue layer 3, where the `letI` algebra instances are
420	assembled.) -/
421	theorem actRes_isoSpec_hom_toSpecAut (hUa : IsAffineOpen U) (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
422	    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
423	    ((ρ.restrict hU).act γ).hom ≫ hUa.isoSpec.hom
424	      = hUa.isoSpec.hom ≫ (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) Γ(X, U) γ).hom := by
425	  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
426	  rw [restrict_act_hom, toSpecAut_hom]
427	  have hhom : CommRingCat.ofHom
428	      (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom (L ≃ₐ[K] L) Γ(X, U) γ⁻¹) = ρ.actApp hU γ := by
429	    refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun s => ?_)
430	    change (ρ.actApp hU (γ⁻¹)⁻¹).hom s = (ρ.actApp hU γ).hom s
431	    rw [inv_inv]
432	  rw [hhom]
433	  exact ρ.actRes_isoSpec_hom hU hUa γ
